```yaml
name: Dependabot Security Fixes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'   # run daily at midnight UTC
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Harden runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          allowed-endpoints: |
            api.github.com
            registry.npmjs.org
            proxy.golang.org
          egress-policy: block
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable-telemetry: true
          disable-sudo: true
          disable-file-monitoring: true

      - name: Create work‑branch
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b dependabot-security-fixes

      # ---------- Go ----------
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/go.sum'

      - name: Update Go dependencies
        run: |
          cd backend/services/bulkdata/http
          go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.45.0
          go get golang.org/x/sys@v0.38.0
          go mod tidy
          git add go.mod go.sum
          git diff --quiet || git commit -m "chore: update Go dependencies for security fixes"

      # ---------- npm socketio ----------
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            backend/services/utils/socketio/package-lock.json
            frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: Update npm dependencies in socketio
        run: |
          cd backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm install express@4.22.1
          npm install qs@^6.14.2 body-parser@^1.20.4
          npm audit fix --force
          git add package.json package-lock.json
          git diff --quiet || git commit -m "chore: update socketio npm dependencies for security fixes"

      # ---------- npm frontend ----------
      - name: Update npm dependencies in frontend
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm install next@15.5.12 koa@3.0.3 js-yaml@4.1.1 eslint@8.57.1 eslint-config-next@15.5.12
          npm audit fix --force
          git add package.json package-lock.json
          git diff --quiet || git commit -m "chore: update frontend npm dependencies for security fixes"

      - name: Push changes
        run: |
          git push --set-upstream origin dependabot-security-fixes

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: dependabot-security-fixes
          base: main
          title: "chore: update dependencies for security fixes"
          body: |
            This PR updates Go and npm dependencies to address all open Dependabot security alerts.
          commit-message: "chore: update dependencies for security fixes"
          delete-branch: true
```
